Options

Platform appearance, accessibility, notifications, and plugin options

Appearance
Theme Visual colour scheme applied to the entire dashboard
Font Font family applied globally to all UI text
UI Density Controls spacing in sidebar, cards, forms, and tables
Accessibility
Larger Font Size Increases base font size for improved readability
Reduce Animations Disables transitions and fade effects
High Contrast Mode Increases contrast ratios for text and interactive elements
Enhanced Focus Indicators Adds visible focus rings for keyboard navigation
Notifications
Enable Notifications Master switch - disables all toasts and notification history entries
Success Notifications Show green success toasts and notifications
Warning Notifications Show amber warning toasts and notifications
Error Notifications Show red error toasts and notifications
Info Notifications Show blue informational toasts and notifications
Notification Duration How long toasts remain visible before auto-dismissing
Notification Position Where toast notifications appear on screen
Dashboard Preferences
Show Plugin Cards Display plugin widget cards on the Dashboard
Compact Dashboard Reduces padding and spacing on the Dashboard view
Remember Last Opened View Reopen to the last view you were on
Logging
Log Level Controls which log entries are recorded in the Activity log
Extension Behavior
Default Launch Mode Choose how ReplyCators opens when you click the toolbar icon
Popup Window Size
Size Preset Sets the width and height when ReplyCators opens as a popup. Browser limit: 800 x 600 px max. Does not affect Side Panel.
Custom Dimensions Width: 400-800 px. Height: 300-600 px. Browser enforces 800 x 600 maximum.

Snake
Game Speed Movement speed of the snake - Classic matches the original retro arcade feel
Salesforce Case Extractor
Output Format How extracted case data is formatted
Auto-fill Case Number Detect case number from active tab automatically
Bob Working Directory Absolute path where the bob command is executed (e.g. C:\Work\Bob). Type or paste the path, then click Save to validate and apply. Required to use the Execute button.
Note: this path is written to a temporary prompt file used by bob. Do not set it to a location that should not contain case-related content.
BobShell 2.0 API Key API key for BobShell 2.0. Required when using Bob 2.0 - obtain from your IBM Bob account settings. Type or paste the key, then click Save to apply. The key is set as an environment variable in the PowerShell session when Execute runs. Disabled when "API key not required" is checked below.
API key not required Check this if you are using Bob 1.0. The API key field will be disabled and BOB_API_KEY will not be set when Execute runs.
Diagnostic Mode When enabled, the Bob terminal window stays open after execution and displays resolved paths, exit code, and timing. For troubleshooting only - disable after use.
Workspace Starter
Tab Groups Automatically group launched tabs under the workspace profile name (requires Edge 89+)
Apptio Documentation Finder
Save search history Remember search queries in the Recent tab
Save opened history Remember opened IBM Docs pages in the Opened tab
Refresh categories Reload documentation source list from IBM Documentation. Use when IBM adds or renames Apptio products.
Clear search & opened history Permanently delete all saved search queries and opened document history from this browser.

Cloudability OrgID v4.0.4 Retrieving…
Source: -
-
Organisation -
Automatic retrieval
OrgID is retrieved automatically when the extension opens if Cloudability is the active tab (the tab you are currently viewing). Background Cloudability tabs are not detected. Switch to your Cloudability tab (*.apptio.com/cloudability*) then click Refresh OrgID.
When to use Refresh
Use Refresh OrgID only if the value is missing or stale. If retrieval times out, navigate to Cloudability → Settings manually then retry.

Example Plugin v1.0.2

Hello, World!

This is the Example Plugin - the canonical reference implementation for the ReplyCators AI Plugin Kit.

Use it to understand the plugin architecture, as a baseline for new plugins, or as a migration target.

AI Plugin Kit

Create a plugin from scratch, use this Example Plugin as a baseline, or convert an existing browser extension into a ReplyCators plugin. Open docs/AI-PLUGIN-KIT.md for architecture, migration instructions, templates, and implementation checklists.

Flat-Runtime Capabilities Demonstrated
  • Registration - window.ReplyCatorsPlugins.ExamplePlugin
  • Lifecycle - init(), onNavigate(), onLeave()
  • Platform logging - app().addLog()
  • Platform notifications - app().addNotification() / app().showToast()
  • Platform navigation - app().navigateTo()
  • Lazy-init pattern - no async I/O in init()
  • Widget wiring - button handler bound in init()

Optional scaffolding: npm run create-plugin - see docs/AI-PLUGIN-KIT.md for the full guide.
